records.name: Rimbertas
records.facts_used: Rimbertas: The name belongs to the Rimbertas / Rimbertus / Rembert family. Its linguistic basis is explained through Germanic ragin, counsel, and berht, bright or famous. The historical connection survives changes of spelling and endings across languages. The beginning of a particular local form’s use must be distinguished from the earlier history of the whole family. The Lithuanian encyclopaedia calls the chronicler Rimbertus/Rembert Rimbertas. He became archbishop of Hamburg–Bremen in 865 and wrote Vita Anskarii around 865–876. This is a Lithuanian rendering of a foreign historical person’s name, rather than a first registration in Lithuania.
